verdict.rationale: Unreal supports event-driven automation via Blueprint event graphs, C++ delegates that bind to functions and fire at runtime, and Python/Editor Scripting utilities that can hook into editor events for automated actions (e.g., asset processing). These are genuine trigger-action mechanisms usable by non-programmers (Blueprints) and programmers (delegates/Python) alike. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified 'rules engine' or event-condition-action framework, no independent/hands-on corroboration of building such automations, and no AI-specific tooling for authoring these rules.
